name: attack_sequence
summary: One attack action by loadout: the attack, the jab, the full attack, or the circle cut, each strike its own roll through the combat pipeline.

action.description: The action (actions/core.json); its strikes and AP come from the loadout's attack_sequences row. opportunity is one melee attack out of turn, a reaction at no AP (docs/core/combat.md#opportunity-attacks).

ap.description: The attacker's AP left. A full attack and a circle cut spend all of it and need at least the attack AP + full_attack.min_extra_ap; an attack or a jab with fewer than its AP is an error. An opportunity attack is a reaction and needs none.

off_skill.description: The off-hand weapon skill; the main-hand skill when left out. A Boss Strike bash rolls on it (the Shields skill) and needs it.

flags.description: Flags from conditions, as in combat.

weapon_properties.description: The main-hand weapon's properties, as combat's attacker.weapon_properties.

weapon_effects.description: The main-hand weapon's on-hit applied effects (a bound weapon's bane, lingering damage, ...), as combat's attacker.weapon_effects.

off_weapon_properties.description: The off-hand weapon's properties; none when left out.

off_weapon_effects.description: The off-hand weapon's on-hit applied effects; none when left out: an off-hand weapon never borrows the main hand's.

shield_dr.description: The carried shield's DR: a Boss Strike bash's damage is this plus the damage roll. A bash without it is an error.

perks.description: The attacker's perk refs, as combat's attacker.perks: every strike reads them for a rider (docs/core/actions.md#rider-perks).

modifiers.description: The attacker's perks and fighting stance (the stance command's modifiers): adds on full_attack_strikes, full_attack_off_strikes, mainhand_penalty, offhand_penalty, attack_roll (every strike), attack_single_opponent (every strike with one foe in reach), attack_after_parry (the first main-hand strike when after_parry), and unarmed_damage (an empty main hand), and boss_strike (the Boss Strike tier), and the carry_through, reaping_arc, scissor_cut, can_circle_cut, off_hand_parries, and carry_on_crit grants.

items.description: A combat defender (combat.json input defender), without the attack's rolls.

foes.description: The foes in reach, in the order a carry picks them; foe 0 is a full attack's target.

damage.description: The main-hand damage type and attribute; each strike's roll is in rolls.

off_damage.description: The off-hand damage type and attribute; damage when left out.

rolls.description: One attack roll and one damage roll per strike made, in order; a lost strike takes none.

targets.description: An attack's or a jab's foe per strike (indexes into foes); all 0 when left out.

situations.description: Keys in ruleset/data/combat/situations.json for every strike, as in combat (flanking, beside_summon, ...).

summoning.description: Whether the attacker has an active summon (not a minion), for every strike's while_summoning modifiers, as in combat. Default false.

disengaged.description: With opportunity: the foe left reach with Disengage, so no attack.

reactions_used.description: With opportunity: the reactions the attacker already used since its last turn. Default 0.

after_block.description: The attacker just blocked a hit in their band: from Boss Strike's after_block tier a bash jab costs shield_bash.after_block_ap.

after_parry.description: The attacker parried a hit since their last strike: attack_after_parry adds to the first main-hand strike (Espada y Daga, docs/core/combat.md#fighting-stances).

attack.description: The strike's attack value after the penalty perks.

carried.description: The strike went to another foe because its own dropped (carry_through).

free.description: The free strike carry_through gives after an action's last strike drops a foe.

scissor.description: Scissor Cut counted the off-hand dice once more.

weapon_effects.description: The weapon effects that landed, as combat's; listed only when the strike's hand has weapon effects.

bash.description: A Boss Strike shield bash: the off-hand strike made with the shield, shield_bash.damage_type damage of shield_dr plus the damage roll. Left out on any other strike.

stagger_ap.description: A bash's stagger: AP the target loses on its next turn (shield_bash.stagger_ap from the stagger tier, on a hit); 0 otherwise. Left out on any other strike.

rider.description: The maneuver a held rider perk put on the strike, as combat's; left out when no rider rides.

effects.description: The rider's effects on a hit, as combat's; left out when no rider rides.

events.description: The rider's events on a hit, as combat's; left out when no rider rides.

save.description: The rider's attempt on a hit (attribute, dc, target), as combat's; left out otherwise.

hp.description: Each foe's HP after the action.

lost.description: Strikes lost because their foe dropped and nothing carried them.

fired.description: With opportunity: whether the attack happened.

reason.description: With opportunity, when it did not fire: why.
